name: Minestrone Soup with Kidney Beans, Green Beans, Carrots & Pasta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
0.68 kg green beans

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse kidney beans; set aside to drain further.
When the veggies are soft, add broth and tomatoes; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the soup is boiling, add the kidney beans and pasta; stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally until the pasta is partially cooked, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green beans into 1-inch pieces.
Add green beans to the soup and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta and veggies are tender, 3-5 minutes more.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
